thread:
Alex (PM): Quick sync — proposing a sourcing calendar for the next DP cohort + clear rollback triggers. Can we sketch timeline and qualifying metrics?
Maya (Design): +1. want a biweekly invite window, and a small standby pool. :calendar:
Diego (Eng): timeline ok. need to know expected traffic so infra can reserve slots. how many concurrent seats?
Alex (PM): target 25 active partners, 40 invites to account for declines. concurrency ~8-10 active at any moment.
Priya (Research): for signal, we need 5 canonical tasks per partner and 10 eval prompts. capture both qualitative and perf metrics.
Maya (Design): suggested recruitment calendar: week 1 outreach, week 2 interviews, week 3 onboarding batch A, week 5 batch B. keep onboarding docs ready by week 2.
Diego (Eng): ops note: we'll provision a dedicated shard for onboarding weeks, autoscale off by default. share a CSV with invite list.
Alex (PM): rollback triggers proposal: immediate rollback if >10% regression on core evals OR >5 P1 incidents in 24h OR sustained latency p95 >500ms for >30m. thoughts?
Priya (Research): add quality signal: >15% of partner sessions flagged for hallucinations or severe formatting failures triggers rollback candidate.
Maya (Design): also include a customer-facing rollback message template and a post-rollout comms checklist we can use. I'll draft.
Diego (Eng): agree on thresholds, but can we make rollout staged: canary 10% partners -> 50% -> 100% with auto-hold on trigger. OpsBot: Deploy plan created: canary windows: 24h, monitor hooks configured (latency, error-rate, custom-evals).
Alex (PM): ok action items: Maya draft comms template + onboarding checklist (due EOD Thu). Priya create eval-set + thresholds (due Fri). Diego upload capacity plan + invite CSV (due Fri). I'll consolidate calendar and run invite cadence.
Maya (Design): tagging for docs: #dp-onboarding, I'll drop first draft in doc link: https://redwood.docs/dp-onboard-draft
Priya (Research): I'll share eval metrics snippet here once ready: small snippet to run as post-deploy smoke check.
Diego (Eng): putting infra notes in the runbook. snippet for autoscale override:```bash
redwood infra reserve --pool dp-onboard --gpus 4 --until 2024-11-01
```
Alex (PM): last Q — anyone want to be point-of-contact for real-time incident triage during canary?
Diego (Eng): I'll be on-call for canary day 1. Maya can handle comms. Priya monitors quality metrics.
Alex (PM): perfect. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff next Tue 9am PT. Invite going out now. :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): :white_check_mark:
Priya (Research): noted.
Diego (Eng): ack.
OpsBot: Calendar event created: "DP Cohort Sourcing + Rollback Kickoff" Tue 09:00 PT.
